name: Hitoyoshi Castle
description: Hitoyoshi Castle was the seat of the Sagara clan, rulers of the Kuma river valley for 700 years. Its riverside stone walls, triple moats and reconstructed turret sit at the edge of the castle town, a base for the Kuma river boat rides.
notes: The castle ruins park is free; the 1977-reconstructed turret houses a small museum (¥200).
